description: Check FirmaDB country and field coverage before planning a lookup, enrichment, or compliance workflow. Use this when an agent needs to know whether fields such as employee_count, nace_code, dissolution_date, website, or source_url are populated for a country. Returns supported countries, field availability percentages, freshness class, known limitations, and recommended fallback behavior. Cheap, cacheable. Do NOT use this to retrieve company records — call search/get/verify/enrich tools for company data.

country.description: ISO alpha-2. Omit for all countries.

name: firmadb_check_coverage
